items.uz: U muhtoj oilalarga yordam berish uchun ko'ngilli bo'ldi.
items.en: He/she volunteered to help families in need.

items.uz: Bu xayriya jamg'armasi ko'plab bolalarga yordam berdi.
items.en: This charity fund has helped many children.

items.uz: Biz kiyim-kechak yig'ib, muhtojlarga tarqatdik.
items.en: We collected clothes and distributed them to those in need.

items.uz: Ko'ngillilar bepul mehnat qilishadi.
items.en: Volunteers work for free.

items.uz: Bu tashkilot yordam so'ragan har bir kishiga qo'l cho'zadi.
items.en: This organization extends a hand to everyone who asks for help.

items.uz: Men har oy ozgina pul xayriyaga ajrataman.
items.en: I set aside a little money for charity every month.

items.uz: Bu tadbir mablag' yig'ish maqsadida uyushtirildi.
items.en: This event was organized to raise funds.

items.uz: Ko'ngillilik ishi menga katta mamnuniyat baxsh etadi.
items.en: Volunteer work gives me great satisfaction.

items.uz: Ular kasalxonaga sovg'alar olib borishdi.
items.en: They brought gifts to the hospital.

items.uz: Yordam berish hech qachon ortiqcha bo'lmaydi.
items.en: Helping is never excessive.

items.uz: Bu jamoat oriyat uylariga yordam ko'rsatadi.
items.en: This community supports orphanages.

items.uz: Kichik yaxshilik ham katta o'zgarish yasashi mumkin.
items.en: Even a small kindness can make a big difference.

items.uz: Bu qo'shiq mening sevimli qo'shig'im.
items.en: This song is my favorite song.

items.uz: U klassik musiqani yaxshi ko'radi.
items.en: He/she loves classical music.

items.uz: Bu film g'oyat ta'sirli edi.
items.en: This movie was extremely moving.

items.uz: Rejissyor bu asarda yangi uslub qo'llagan.
items.en: The director used a new style in this work.

items.uz: Konsertda minglab odam ishtirok etdi.
items.en: Thousands of people attended the concert.

items.uz: Bu aktyor rolini juda mahorat bilan o'ynadi.
items.en: This actor played his/her role very skillfully.

items.uz: Men gitara chalishni o'rganmoqchiman.
items.en: I want to learn to play the guitar.

items.uz: Bu film mukofotga sazovor bo'ldi.
items.en: This film was awarded a prize.

items.uz: Qo'shiqning so'zlari juda ma'noli.
items.en: The song's lyrics are very meaningful.

items.uz: U studiyada yangi albom yozmoqda.
items.en: He/she is recording a new album in the studio.

items.uz: Bu kino janri meni doim qiziqtirgan.
items.en: This film genre has always interested me.

items.uz: Musiqa insonning kayfiyatini o'zgartira oladi.
items.en: Music can change a person's mood.
